```{r}
source("machine_learning_survival.R")
# Clean up and prepare dataset
data <- na.omit(pbc) %>%
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         status_event = as.integer(status == 2))

df_outcome  <- data %>% select(time, status_event)
df_features <- data %>% select(-time, -status, -status_event)

results <- cross_validation_custom(
  df_features = df_features,
  df_outcome = df_outcome,
  outcome_col = "time",
  event_col = "status_event",
  ml_options = list(nb_folds = 3, nb_repeats = 1, ncores = 8),
  file_name = "Test"
)

```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(censored)

# Prepare data
data(pbc)
df <- na.omit(pbc) %>%
  mutate(event = as.integer(status == 2)) %>%
  select(time, event, age, albumin, bili, protime)

set.seed(123)
idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df)), size = 0.7 * nrow(df))
train <- df[idx, ]
test  <- df[-idx, ]

# Fit Cox model
cox_fit <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ age + albumin + bili + protime, data = train)

# Predict on test
test$.pred <- predict(cox_fit, newdata = test, type = "lp")

# Compute C-index
test_cindex <- concordance_survival_vec(
  truth = Surv(test$time, test$event),
  estimate = test$.pred
)

# Plot performance
plot_survival_performance(
  df_test = test,
  c_index = test_cindex,
  n_groups = 3,
  title = "Cox model survival performance (test set)"
)

new_patient <- tibble(
  age = 65,
  albumin = 3.1,
  bili = 2.0,
  protime = 11.5
)

# Predict 1-year survival probability
surv_curve <- survfit(cox_fit, newdata = new_patient)
summary(surv_curve, times = 365)$surv

#predict(cox_fit, new_patient, type = "survival", eval_time = 365)
```

LODO test
```{r}
# ===============================================================
# Example: test LODO-stratified cross-validation
# ===============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(rsample)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(parallel)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Simulate example dataset
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)

n <- 200
n_batches <- 5

df_features <- tibble(
  x1 = rnorm(n),
  x2 = runif(n),
  x3 = rnorm(n, 2)
)

df_outcome <- tibble(
  time  = rexp(n, rate = 0.05),
  event = rbinom(n, 1, prob = 0.6),
  cohort = sample(paste0("C", 1:n_batches), size = n, replace = TRUE)
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Test LODO stratification (by event + cohort)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
message("\n=== LODO-style stratified CV (by cohort × event) ===")
training_lodo <- cross_validation_custom(
  df_features = df_features,
  df_outcome  = df_outcome,
  outcome_col = "time",
  event_col   = "event",
  ml_options  = list(nb_folds = 5, nb_repeats = 1, ncores = 2, LODO = TRUE, batch_id = "cohort")
)

# To inspect the stratification balance, rebuild the same structure manually
df_all <- df_features %>% bind_cols(df_outcome) %>%
  mutate(strata = interaction(cohort, event, drop = TRUE))

folds_lodo <- rsample::vfold_cv(
  df_all,
  v = 5,
  strata = "strata"
)

cat("\nEvent rate and cohort composition per fold (proportions):\n")

# overall reference distribution in the full data
ref_dist <- df_outcome %>%
  count(cohort, event) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(cohort, event)

cat("\nReference distribution (full data):\n")
print(ref_dist)

for (i in seq_along(folds_lodo$splits)) {
  fold_data <- rsample::analysis(folds_lodo$splits[[i]])
  summary_tbl <- fold_data %>%
    count(cohort, event) %>%
    mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
    arrange(cohort, event)
  
  cat(paste0("\nFold ", i, ":\n"))
  print(summary_tbl)
}

```
